player_intent: Pick up the AGLS field pack and wear it in the local game and multiplayer.
acceptance_rule: Interact awards one available pack to one nearby living admitted player, rejects walls/range/stale-life requests, hides the ground mesh, and reliably reproduces the wearer for current and late-joining peers. Death, respawn, disconnect and round/session reset restore availability. Existing bomb-pack presentation retains priority.

ownership.attachment_transform: BoneAttachment3D follows canonical spine without override

nodes.role: Server pickup state and replicated presentation

visual_check: Run focused regression with --visual in a rendered Godot process. Inspect ground pack, rear and side worn views on canonical rig. Check spine binding and bomb priority. No authored pickup animation or full inventory is claimed.

system_delta.reason: The existing backpack owner only supports demolition. Keep it intact and add one shared, bounded field-item component to both canonical playable roots. Reuse the spine attachment convention and existing interaction action; import only AGLS presentation data.

candidate.system: Shared server-owned field pack with AGLS mesh
